author.name: First Press by Press On Ventures

media:group.media:title: The AEO Playbook with Jake Makler | First Press Ep. 05
media:group.media:description:
Search is changing. As AI reshapes how consumers discover brands, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) is becoming an increasingly important part of the marketing playbook.
On this episode of First Press, a Press On Ventures podcast, Madeline Litvack and Josh Neckes sit down with Jake Makler to break down AEO: what it is, how it differs from traditional SEO, how AI-powered search is changing consumer discovery, and what brands should be doing now to stay visible and relevant.
